material_findings: sha256_file used pathname stat/open/stat without descriptor binding; parquet_rows and audit_raw passed pathnames directly to PyArrow after separate checks; model loading likewise used pathname files after separate manifest checks. These paths remained vulnerable to exchange-and-restore TOCTOU substitution.
validate_result did not require config.evidence_ledger_mutation to be false, so a correctly self-digested config could declare a prohibited ledger mutation.
disposition: V24 sealed without an acceptance receipt, acquisition, model effects, or published result. A fresh V25 identity is required for correction.
